items.issue: SIGINT during gate spawn still leaks the gate process: _child_from_exception can recover a Popen whose pid is None, so _kill_gate raises TypeError (masking the KeyboardInterrupt) and the forked gate survives while the outer LOCK_UN releases the flock. A second hole sits between Popen() returning and the proc= store. Measured 68 leaked gates in 1500 trials. Remedy: defer SIGINT the way SIGTERM is deferred, which also removes _child_from_exception and _POPEN_TYPE.
